note: Frozen WASI Preview 1 import surface of the zlib-free WASI-C niimath reactor (M1). CI must fail if this set GROWS without review (a new import = a new host-VFS syscall to implement/audit). Generated by inspecting the built niimath-wasi.wasm with WebAssembly.Module.imports.

notes_per_import.clock_time_get: timing/logging; host returns a monotonic-ish counter (deterministic for reproducibility)
notes_per_import.environ_get/environ_sizes_get: getenv(FSLOUTPUTTYPE) etc.; host supplies a small fixed environ
notes_per_import.fd_read/fd_write/fd_seek/fd_close/fd_fds: wasi-libc stdio over the host VFS + stdout/stderr capture on fd 1/2
notes_per_import.fd_prestat_get/fd_prestat_dir_name: preopen handshake: the host presents one preopened '.' directory (fd 3) so relative paths resolve into the VFS
notes_per_import.path_open: fopen -> opens/creates a VFS file relative to the preopen dir
notes_per_import.path_filestat_get: stat(pathname) for raw NIfTI input size (nifti_io.c)
notes_per_import.poll_oneoff: pulled in by libc; stubbed (no polling in the compute path)
notes_per_import.proc_exit: exit() on error paths -> typed host exception; adapter discards the instance

not_imported_significant.random_get: ABSENT — wasi-libc rand() is a deterministic PRNG; the allineate coarse search does not draw host entropy, aiding cross-run reproducibility
not_imported_significant.fd_filestat_get: ABSENT — stat uses path_filestat_get; fd-based filestat not needed
not_imported_significant.fd_tell: ABSENT — tell is expressed as fd_seek(whence=CUR)
